QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_9

question.text: As per SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, NPOs may issue ZCZP Instruments through which of the following channels?

answer.text: Public Issue to the public, or Private Issue to Social Impact Funds registered under SEBI (AIF) Regulations.
Public Issue only, open exclusively to retail investors above 18 years of age.
Private Issue only, restricted to Qualified Institutional Buyers.
Rights Issue to existing donors of the NPO, capped at 10% of prior-year receipts.

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 2.3.1.3 states ZCZPs may be issued (a) to public through a Public Issue, or (b) to Social Impact Funds registered under SEBI (AIF) Regulations through a Private Issue. Rule 19 of the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules 1957 applies to the public issuance. The provisions for public issuance apply mutatis mutandis to private issuance to Social Impact Funds. The Trap: Option B wrongly excludes private placement to Social Impact Funds. Option C wrongly excludes retail and public participation. Option D invents a rights-issue route that does not exist in ICDR. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B/C/D/E (AIF) treats Cat I AIF Social Impact Fund private placement mechanics. III-A/III-C (Compliance) applies Rule 19 across listing segments. Assessor's Pro-Tip: In your fieldwork, capture both the public-issue fund-raising document AND any private-placement memorandum to Social Impact Funds — some NPOs run dual channels in the same year, and omitting one distorts the SROI / outcome base in your Annual Impact Report.
